expectations.text: Claude produces a hop-by-hop trace starting from the webhook entry point (controller/route/handler)
expectations.evidence: 10-hop trace starting at 'HTTP POST /webhooks/stripe → src/controllers/WebhookController.ts:14'. Entry point is the first hop.

expectations.text: Claude identifies the file and method where the notification logic would be added
expectations.evidence: Explicitly calls out hop [9] as the gap: 'src/services/WebhookService.ts:35 — THIS IS THE GAP — nothing calls MailerService here yet.'

expectations.text: Claude asks one focused question after the trace — not a bulleted list of questions
expectations.evidence: Single question in Step 3: 'does it contain the customer's email address, or does WebhookService need another call to get it?' — one question, no list.

expectations.text: Claude does not immediately tell the engineer what to implement before they have located the change themselves
